description: Search 170+ launch directories (DR, free plan, dofollow rule) and this week’s indie product launches on LaunchWren.
name: LaunchWren

tools.name: search_directories
tools.title: Search launch directories
tools.description: Search 173 launch directories and Product Hunt alternatives that LaunchWren compares: domain rating (DR), free plan, wait time, link type (dofollow or nofollow), and what the free plan needs. Data checked 2026-11-05.

query.description: Text to match in the directory name or URL.

free_only.description: Only directories with a free plan.

dofollow_only.description: Only directories that give a dofollow link.

no_badge.description: Only directories whose free listing does not need a badge or backlink on your site.

tools.name: list_launches
tools.title: List weekly launches
tools.description: List the products launching on LaunchWren in one week (Monday to Sunday, UTC), with tagline, category, pricing, votes and rank.

week.description: Monday of the week as YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the current week.

tools.name: get_launch
tools.title: Get one launch
tools.description: Get the details of one LaunchWren launch by its slug (the part after /p/ in its URL).
